summary: Complete testing of server-side pagination for FX Trading Tracker. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified pagination on all pages: My Deals (Trader), Deal Queue (Treasury), Transaction History (Admin), Users (Admin). CSV export correctly exports all records regardless of pagination.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/deals?page=1&limit=5 returns {deals:[], total, page, pages} format
Backend: GET /api/deals?page=2&limit=5 returns different deals than page 1
Backend: limit parameter controls number of results returned
Backend: Pagination works with status filter (status=pending&page=1&limit=5)
Backend: Pagination works with multiple combined filters
Backend: Pages calculation is correct (total/limit rounded up)
Backend: GET /api/users?page=1&limit=5 returns {users:[], total, page, pages} format
Backend: GET /api/users?search=trader returns filtered results
Backend: /api/users requires admin role (403 for non-admin)
Backend: Search + pagination combined works for users
Backend: CSV export returns ALL records (not paginated)
Backend: CSV export with filter returns all matching records
Backend: Treasury sees paginated deals
Backend: Page beyond max returns empty deals list
Backend: Default limit is 20 when not specified
Backend: Invalid page=0 handled correctly
Frontend Trader: My Deals shows '37 deals' total count
Frontend Trader: Pagination shows 'Page 1 of 2 (37 deals)'
Frontend Trader: Next/Previous buttons work - different data on page 2
Frontend Treasury: Deal Queue loads paginated data (Page 1 of 2)
Frontend Treasury: Pending/Processed tabs work with correct counts
Frontend Admin: Transaction History shows 'Page 1 of 2 (37 transactions)'
Frontend Admin: TX pagination controls work
Frontend Admin: Users page shows '3 users' (single page, no pagination visible)
Frontend Admin: Users search filters correctly (search 'trader' shows 1 user)
Frontend: CSV Export exports ALL 37 records even when viewing page 2
seed_data_creation: Used existing 37 deals and 3 users from previous test iterations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server-side pagination fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/deals returns {deals:[], total, page, pages}. GET /api/users returns {users:[], total, page, pages} with optional search param. Default page size is 20. GET /api/deals/export is NOT paginated - returns all matching records. Frontend pagination controls use data-testid: deals-prev-page, deals-next-page, treasury-prev-page, treasury-next-page, tx-prev-page, tx-next-page, users-prev-page, users-next-page.

response_format.deals: {deals: [], total: int, page: int, pages: int}
response_format.users: {users: [], total: int, page: int, pages: int}

csv_export.details: CSV export correctly exports all 37 records regardless of current page being viewed
